definitions.explanation: A period of history from the distant past, typically before the medieval period.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}ギリシャの{文明|ぶんめい}
{古代|こだい}の{遺跡|いせき}を{発掘|はっくつ}する。
{古代|こだい}{日本|にほん}の{歴史|れきし}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: To study the history of ancient Japan.

notes:
{古代|こだい} refers to the earliest period of recorded history. In Japanese historiography, it typically covers the period up to around the 12th century (before the {鎌倉|かまくら}{時代|じだい}).

JAPANESE HISTORICAL PERIODS:
- {古代|こだい}: ancient (up to ~12th century)
- {中世|ちゅうせい}: medieval (~12th-16th century)
- {近世|きんせい}: early modern (~16th-19th century)
- {近代|きんだい}: modern (Meiji onwards)
- {現代|げんだい}: contemporary

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古代|こだい}{文明|ぶんめい}: ancient civilization
- {古代|こだい}{遺跡|いせき}: ancient ruins
- {古代|こだい}{史|し}: ancient history
- {古代|こだい}ギリシャ: ancient Greece
- {古代|こだい}エジプト: ancient Egypt

USAGE:
Also functions as a no-adjective: {古代|こだい}の{人々|ひとびと} (ancient people).
